title: Closed Surface
governance_note: Surface must fully enclose the selected volume.

title: Outward Normal
governance_note: Outward normals define positive boundary flux.

title: Boundary Flux
governance_note: Boundary flux measures net crossing through the closed surface.

title: Interior Divergence
governance_note: Interior divergence measures accumulated source-sink behavior.

title: Resolution Review
governance_note: Surface and volume estimates should be checked under refinement.
